final: WITH bucket_stats AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) as bucket_count FROM riskandmargin r INNER JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), totals AS (SELECT SUM(bucket_count) as total_records, COUNT(*) as num_buckets, 1.0 / CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) as avg_share FROM bucket_stats), shares AS (SELECT bs.timespan, bs.bucket_count, CAST(bs.bucket_count AS REAL) / t.total_records as share, t.avg_share FROM bucket_stats bs CROSS JOIN totals t), above_avg AS (SELECT * FROM shares WHERE share > avg_share) SELECT SUM(bucket_count) as total_count_above_avg, AVG(share) as avg_share_of_above_avg, AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM totals LIMIT 1) as avg_distance_above_avg FROM above_avg
